title: Actual quotient descent against the explicit constant diagram
statement: Given X,d,M,V,T, use the explicit constant levels and transitions [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-constant-normalization]. FinitePerfectAdicActualNormalization comprises etale actual levels K_n with bounded finite lisse cohomology, sourcewise universal coherent consecutive coefficient arrows [def-weil-pbc-etale-universal-normalization], and inhabited geometric stalks of the Isom sheaf from the explicit constant level to K_n. It also supplies scalar-forgetting realization functors on U_proet to completed-ring modules on every W→U, coefficient interchange, actual and model level comparisons, and both consecutive normalization identities with the actual strict and model diagrams [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data]. It has no Isom-presheaf reduction maps and no assertion of boundedness, lisse cohomology, or universality for the constant diagram.
